goal: Add a complete trainer resume boundary from serialized checkpoint data without coupling callers to backend internals.

operations.old: Trainer checkpoints now carry optional backend-owned state through the backend lifecycle boundary and restore it through `load_state()` without exposing framework-specific serialization. The next solver step should expose a concrete trainer resume flow around serialized checkpoints, without wiring policy execution into Arena yet.
operations.new: Trainer checkpoints now carry optional backend-owned state through the backend lifecycle boundary and restore it through `load_state()` without exposing framework-specific serialization.
